source_policy: Original DEC excerpts and full source provenance are private; only reusable invariants are published.

learning.principle: Bind readiness and publication state to stable object identity; do not share caches or baselines across repositories.
Check the object and every ancestor with lstat/reparse identity; reject links before reads/writes.
Known-failure tests, nonempty execution and real scope are part of a gate; observation does not consume unreviewed learning.

limits: These are narrow engineering invariants, not crash root-cause claims, specialist certification or measured model-quality gains.
